weaponModifications.name: Finely Balanced
weaponModifications.effect: Improve the Weapon Skill (WS) or Ballistic Skill (BS) of this weapon by 1.

weaponModifications.name: Brutal
weaponModifications.effect: Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of this weapon.

weaponModifications.name: Armour Piercing
weaponModifications.effect: Improve the Armour Penetration (AP) characteristic of this weapon by 1.

weaponModifications.name: Master-worked
weaponModifications.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this weapon.

weaponModifications.name: Heirloom
weaponModifications.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this weapon.

weaponModifications.name: Precise
weaponModifications.effect: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, an unmodified Wound roll of 6 scores a Critical Wound (which triggers [PRECISION] and other critical effects).

battleTraits.name: Born Hunter
battleTraits.effect: This unit has the Scouts 9" ability.

battleTraits.name: Focused Gunners
battleTraits.effect: Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against ranged attacks.

battleTraits.name: Natural Leader
battleTraits.effect: You can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for this unit.

battleTraits.name: Deadly Combatant
battleTraits.effect: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

battleTraits.name: Inspiring Presence
battleTraits.effect: While a friendly unit is within 6" of this Character, add 1 to their Leadership characteristic.

battleTraits.name: Master Strategist
battleTraits.effect: If this unit is on the battlefield, roll a D6 each time you use a Stratagem. On a 5+, you regain 1 CP.

battleTraits.name: Resolute Veterans
battleTraits.effect: Each time you take a Battle-shock, Leadership, or Desperate Escape test for this unit, add 1 to the result.

battleTraits.name: Fleet of Foot
battleTraits.effect: Add 1" to this unit's Move characteristic, and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

battleTraits.name: Drop Zone Defenders
battleTraits.effect: This unit gains the [DEEP STRIKE] ability.

battleTraits.name: Urban Fighters
battleTraits.effect: This unit always has the Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks if they are wholly within a Ruins terrain feature.

battleTraits.name: Elite Marksmen
battleTraits.effect: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit gain the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

battleTraits.name: High Speed Gunnery
battleTraits.effect: Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit gain the [ASSAULT] ability.

battleTraits.name: Predatory Urge
battleTraits.effect: You can re-roll Charge rolls made for this unit.

battleTraits.name: Mounted Guerrillas
battleTraits.effect: This unit is eligible to declare a Charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

battleTraits.name: Reinforced Armour / Thick Hide
battleTraits.effect: Each time an attack is allocated to this unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack (to a minimum of 1).

battleTraits.name: Auto-repair Nodes / Regeneration
battleTraits.effect: At the start of your Command phase, this unit regains 1 lost wound.

battleTraits.name: Behemoth
battleTraits.effect: Add 2 to this unit's Wounds characteristic.

crusadeRelics.name: Artificer Armour
crusadeRelics.effect: The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+ and a 5+ Invulnerable save.

crusadeRelics.name: Artificer Weapon
crusadeRelics.effect: Select one equipped weapon. Improve its Weapon Skill or Ballistic Skill by 1, and add 1 to its Strength and Damage characteristics.

crusadeRelics.name: Master-vox
crusadeRelics.effect: Each time your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll one D6; on a 5+, you gain 1 CP.

crusadeRelics.name: Digital Arsenal
crusadeRelics.effect: Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer gain the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

crusadeRelics.name: Truesilver Weave
crusadeRelics.effect: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

crusadeRelics.name: Blade of the Ordo
crusadeRelics.effect: Melee weapons equipped by the bearer gain the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] and [ANTI-XENOS 4+] abilities.

crusadeRelics.name: Mantle of Majesty
crusadeRelics.effect: The bearer has a 4+ Invulnerable save. While a friendly unit is within 6", add 1 to their Leadership characteristic.

crusadeRelics.name: Conversion Field
crusadeRelics.effect: The bearer has a 4+ Invulnerable save. Each time a melee attack is allocated to the bearer, on an unmodified saving throw of 6, the attacking unit suffers 1 Mortal Wound.

crusadeRelics.name: Standard of Righteous Hatred
crusadeRelics.effect: While a friendly unit is within 6" of the bearer, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

crusadeRelics.name: Tainted Blade
crusadeRelics.effect: Select one melee weapon. It gains +2 Strength, -2 AP, and 2 Damage, but each time an unmodified hit roll of 1 is made with it, the bearer suffers 1 Mortal Wound.

crusadeRelics.name: Icon of Intolerance
crusadeRelics.effect: While a friendly unit is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

crusadeRelics.name: Displacement Field
crusadeRelics.effect: This model's unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

crusadeRelics.name: Halo of the Indomitable
crusadeRelics.effect: The bearer has a 3+ Invulnerable save and a 4+ Feel No Pain ability.

crusadeRelics.name: Vortex Grenade
crusadeRelics.effect: Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, select one point on the battlefield within 12" and roll a D6 for each unit within D3". On a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

crusadeRelics.name: Relic of the Primarch
crusadeRelics.effect: Friendly units gain +1 Attack in melee if within 6" of the bearer. If the bearer is slain, the opponent gains a unique Agenda to recover it.

crusadeRelics.name: Archeotech Curiosity
crusadeRelics.effect: Select one ranged weapon equipped by the bearer. Change its profile to Strength 10, AP -3, Damage 3.

crusadeRelics.name: Null-field Disruptor
crusadeRelics.effect: Each time the bearer makes an attack, the target cannot take Invulnerable saving throws against that attack.

crusadeRelics.name: Gheist Prism Field
crusadeRelics.effect: The bearer gains the [LONE OPERATIVE] and [STEALTH] abilities.

battleScars.name: Crippling Damage
battleScars.effect: This unit cannot Advance. Subtract 1" from the Move characteristic of models in this unit.

battleScars.name: Battle-weary
battleScars.effect: Subtract 1 from Battle-shock, Leadership, Desperate Escape, and Out of Action tests taken for this unit.

battleScars.name: Fatigued
battleScars.effect: Subtract 1 from the Objective Control (OC) characteristic of models in this unit. This unit never receives the Charge bonus.

battleScars.name: Disgraced
battleScars.effect: This unit is unaffected by your Stratagems and cannot be selected for the 'Marked for Greatness' XP bonus.

battleScars.name: Mark of Shame
battleScars.effect: This unit cannot form an Attached unit (cannot be lead/attach as a leader) and is unaffected by Aura abilities.

battleScars.name: Deep Scars
battleScars.effect: Each time an attack targets this unit, a Critical Hit automatically wounds this unit (no Wound roll is made).
